components.name: Box
components.desc: Generic block container mapped to spacing/surface tokens.

components.name: Icon Wrapper
components.desc: Scales/colors inline SVG via currentColor; decorative vs labelled.

components.name: Typography: Headings H1–H6
components.desc: Type scale bound to tokens; visual level decoupled from semantic level.

components.name: Visually Hidden / SR only
components.desc: Hidden visually, available to assistive tech.

components.name: Primary Button
components.desc: Main call-to-action; one per view region.

components.name: IconButton
components.desc: Icon-only button; requires accessible name + tooltip.

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.desc: Switches data-theme via js/theme.js; persists and follows the OS by default.

components.name: Form Field Wrapper
components.desc: Groups label, control, helper and error.

components.name: Date field (memorable date, segmented)
components.desc: Day / month / year text inputs for known dates (birth, issue dates) — no calendar.

components.name: Error Summary
components.desc: Form-level list of errors linking to fields. Core: the form-layout pattern's invalid state depends on it.

components.name: Global Navigation Bar
components.desc: App header: logo, nav, search, profile.

components.name: Page Header
components.desc: Title, meta, actions for a page.

components.name: Toast
components.desc: Transient global notice; pause on hover/focus.

components.name: Result panel
components.desc: Outcome of an action or process: icon, title, explanation, next actions.
